subject: Travel seat issue
text:
Dear friend,

I have been looking at the travel options again, and I think we should choose the earlier bus rather than the train. The train is nicer, but the transfer in the middle would leave us carrying bags through a station that might be confusing in the afternoon. The bus is slower, but it avoids that mess, and I would feel calmer once we are moving. The timing also works better with our club exhibition, since it would give us a little room to find the door without rushing straight from the platform.

There is one small issue with the booking site. It will not let me select two adjacent seats for the return leg, even after clearing the cache and trying another browser. It keeps saying the seat map is temporarily unavailable. I do not think it is serious, but I would like to solve it before we lock in the final numbers. If we can book with one seat changed, we can probably fix the rest later without paying an upgrade. I will try again during lunch, when the site may be quieter, and I can send you a screenshot if it shows the same odd message as well.

Could you check whether you can see the same problem on your account? If not, I can still reserve one ticket for now and add the second when the site settles. Please let me know by tomorrow evening, because the fare changes after six.

Thank you, see you soon.
